name: Advanced Math & Shell Operations
description: Demonstrates arithmetic, string manipulation, parallel calculations, context piping, and conditions

config.command: A={{variables.numA}}; B={{variables.numB}}; SUM=$((A + B)); DIFF=$((A - B)); PROD=$((A * B)); QUOT=$((A / B)); echo "Base: A=$A, B=$B | Sum=$SUM, Diff=$DIFF, Product=$PROD, Quotient=$QUOT"; echo $SUM
VAL=$(echo "{{initial_math.output}}" | tail -n 1); SQ=$((VAL * VAL)); echo "[Square Branch] Square of $VAL is $SQ"; echo $SQ
python3 -c "import math; v=int('''{{initial_math.output}}'''.split()[-1]); print(f'[Stats Branch] Sqrt={math.isqrt(v)}, Factorial(5)={math.factorial(5)}, Hex={hex(v)}')"

echo "=== FINAL REPORT ==="; echo "Raw Initial Output: {{initial_math.output}}"; echo "Square Result: {{parallel_branch_square.output}}"; echo "Stats Output: {{parallel_branch_stats.output}}"; echo "All calculations completed successfully!"
